summary: SAT question bank acquisition and local serving: downloads topic question bundles from the InceptCurriculum API to local JSON files, then serves them via a local FastAPI server with topic listing, topic detail, HTML browse pages, PDF inline view, and PDF download endpoints for both browser and programmatic access. Used to supply training and evaluation data for the question generation pipeline.

evidence.claim: download CLI fetches SAT question bundles from InceptCurriculum API and saves as JSON to local data directory
serve CLI starts a local FastAPI server on port 8765 exposing downloaded question bank data via REST API
GET /api/topics returns a JSONResponse listing all available SAT topic bundles grouped by assessment type
GET /api/topic/{slug} returns a JSONResponse with the full question bundle for the given topic slug
GET / renders an HTMLResponse listing all SAT topic bundles grouped by assessment type with links
GET /topic/{slug} renders an HTMLResponse showing the full question bundle for the given topic slug
GET /pdf/{slug} serves a topic PDF as an inline FileResponse for browser display
GET /pdf/{slug}/download serves a topic PDF as an attachment FileResponse triggering browser download
Download CLI integrates with InceptCurriculum API at api.curriculum.inceptapi.com

invariants.statement: The download step must complete before the serve step has data to expose
The local server runs on port 8765 by default
Data is sourced exclusively from the InceptCurriculum API and stored as local JSON files

scenarios.name: download question bank
scenarios.given: Valid InceptCurriculum API credentials and desired assessment/domain filters
scenarios.then: SAT question bundles are saved as JSON files in the local data directory

scenarios.name: list topics via API
scenarios.given: Previously downloaded question bank data and a running server
scenarios.then: A JSON list of all topic bundles grouped by assessment type is returned

scenarios.name: browse topics in browser
scenarios.when: GET / is opened in a browser
scenarios.then: An HTML page listing all available topic bundles with navigation links is rendered

scenarios.name: download topic PDF
scenarios.given: A topic slug with an associated PDF asset
scenarios.then: The PDF is returned as a file attachment triggering a browser download
